verses.before: “Has not the LORD your God been with you, and given you rest on every side? For he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and before his people.
verses.after: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you?” he said. “Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? He has given the land’s inhabitants into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and his people.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Has not the LORD your God been with you, and given you rest on every side? For he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and before his people.

verses.rationale: Retain heart and whole-person seeking alongside the practical sanctuary purpose.
verses.before: Now set your heart and your whole being to seek the LORD your God. Rise up and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God into the house built for the name of the LORD.”
verses.after: Now set your heart and your whole being on seeking the LORD your God. Get up and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that the ark of the LORD’s covenant and God’s holy utensils may be brought into the house built for the LORD’s name.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Now set your heart and your whole being to seek the LORD your God. Rise up and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God into the house built for the name of the LORD.”

verses.rationale: Preserve the fullness-of-days image and royal installation.
verses.before: When David was old and full of days, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
verses.after: When David was old and full of days, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: When David was old and full of days, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

verses.rationale: Keep all three assembled groups.
verses.before: He gathered all the leaders of Israel, along with the priests and Levites.
verses.after: He gathered all Israel’s leaders, the priests, and the Levites.
verses.tsw_comparator: He gathered all the leaders of Israel, along with the priests and Levites.

verses.rationale: Retain the age threshold and exact total before the later change to twenty.
verses.before: The Levites from thirty years old and upward were counted. Their number, counted individually by men, was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.after: The Levites thirty years old and upward were counted. Their total, counting the men individually, was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Levites from thirty years old and upward were counted. Their number, counted individually by men, was thirty-eight thousand.

verses.rationale: Keep both service categories and their counts.
verses.before: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, and six thousand were officers and judges.
verses.after: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, and six thousand were officials and judges.
verses.tsw_comparator: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, and six thousand were officers and judges.

verses.rationale: Preserve the first-person quotation embedded in the roster.
verses.before: Four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand were to praise the LORD with the instruments that I made for praise.
verses.after: Four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments David said, “I made for praise.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand were to praise the LORD with the instruments that I made for praise.

verses.rationale: Keep the ancestral basis for the divisions.
verses.before: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.after: David organized them into divisions according to Levi’s sons: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.tsw_comparator: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.rationale: Retain the two named branches.
verses.before: For the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
verses.after: From the Gershonites came Ladan and Shimei.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

verses.rationale: Preserve the named leader and confirming total.
verses.before: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel—three.
verses.after: Ladan’s sons were Jehiel the leader, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel—three.

verses.rationale: Follow Shelomith’s read form and retain the relationship to Ladan despite the repeated Shimei name.
verses.before: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran—three. These were the heads of the ancestral houses of Ladan.
verses.after: Shimei’s sons were Shelomith, Haziel, and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of Ladan’s ancestral houses.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran—three. These were the heads of the ancestral houses of Ladan.

verses.rationale: Keep Zina here and the repeated four-son statement.
verses.before: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah—four.
verses.after: Shimei’s sons were Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were Shimei’s sons.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah—four.

verses.rationale: Retain Zizah’s differing form and the reason for combining two families.
verses.before: Jahath was the chief and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they became one ancestral house for one enrollment.
verses.after: Jahath was the leader, and Zizah was second. Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they formed one ancestral house for their assignment.
verses.tsw_comparator: Jahath was the chief and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they became one ancestral house for one enrollment.

verses.rationale: Keep all four branches in order.
verses.before: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four.
verses.after: Kohath’s sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in all.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four.

verses.rationale: Choose the sacred-things reading while noting the alternative consecration of Aaron himself.
verses.before: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his sons forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
verses.after: Amram’s sons were Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his sons were set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, to burn offerings before the LORD, serve him, and bless in his name forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his sons forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

verses.rationale: Preserve the title and the sons’ Levitical classification.
verses.before: But as for Moses, the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
verses.after: As for Moses, the man of God, his sons were counted with the tribe of Levi.
verses.tsw_comparator: But as for Moses, the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

verses.rationale: Keep Gershom distinct from the older Gershon branch.
verses.before: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.after: Moses’ sons were Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.rationale: Retain the single named descendant under a plural Hebrew heading.
verses.before: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
verses.after: Gershom’s descendant was Shebuel the leader.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

verses.rationale: Preserve the contrast between one son and many later descendants.
verses.before: The sons of Eliezer were Rehabiah the chief. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah became exceedingly numerous.
verses.after: Eliezer’s descendant was Rehabiah the leader. Eliezer had no other sons, but Rehabiah’s descendants became very numerous.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Eliezer were Rehabiah the chief. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah became exceedingly numerous.

verses.rationale: Retain this name without harmonizing the following chapter’s Shelomoth.
verses.before: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
verses.after: Izhar’s descendant was Shelomith the leader.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

verses.rationale: Preserve every ordinal and name.
verses.before: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.after: Hebron’s sons were Jeriah the leader, Amariah second, Jahaziel third, and Jekameam fourth.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.rationale: Keep the two ranked sons.
verses.before: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief and Isshiah the second.
verses.after: Uzziel’s sons were Micah the leader and Isshiah second.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief and Isshiah the second.

verses.rationale: Distinguish the two successive generations.
verses.before: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
verses.after: Merari’s sons were Mahli and Mushi. Mahli’s sons were Eleazar and Kish.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

verses.rationale: Retain the daughters and render brothers as the kinship relationship established by the genealogy.
verses.before: Eleazar died without sons, having only daughters; and the sons of Kish, their relatives, married them.
verses.after: Eleazar died without sons; he had only daughters. Their relatives, the sons of Kish, married them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Eleazar died without sons, having only daughters; and the sons of Kish, their relatives, married them.

verses.rationale: Preserve the younger Mahli and the exact three names.
verses.before: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth—three.
verses.after: Mushi’s sons were Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth—three in all.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth—three.

verses.rationale: Keep the lowered age threshold and individual registration.
verses.before: These were the sons of Levi according to their ancestral houses, the heads of the ancestral houses, as they were enrolled by name, individually: those twenty years old and upward who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.after: These were Levi’s descendants by their ancestral houses, the family heads as registered, counted individually by name. They carried out the work of serving the LORD’s house from twenty years old and upward.
verses.tsw_comparator: These were the sons of Levi according to their ancestral houses, the heads of the ancestral houses, as they were enrolled by name, individually: those twenty years old and upward who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Retain rest and permanent dwelling as the reason for reorganization.
verses.before: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people, and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
verses.after: For David had said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given his people rest and will dwell in Jerusalem forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people, and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

verses.rationale: Keep the cessation of transport duties, not a cessation of all service.
verses.before: The Levites also no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of its equipment for its service.”
verses.after: The Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the utensils used in its service.”
verses.tsw_comparator: The Levites also no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of its equipment for its service.”

verses.rationale: Preserve the repeated twenty-year threshold and final instructions.
verses.before: For according to the last words of David, the sons of Levi from twenty years old and upward were counted.
verses.after: Under David’s final instructions, the Levites were counted from twenty years old and upward.
verses.tsw_comparator: For according to the last words of David, the sons of Levi from twenty years old and upward were counted.

verses.rationale: Unfold the service list and preserve the assisting relationship.
verses.before: Their duty was alongside the sons of Aaron in the service of the house of the LORD: concerning the courts and the chambers, the cleansing of every holy thing, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.after: Their station was alongside Aaron’s descendants in the service of the LORD’s house: caring for the courtyards and rooms, purifying all holy things, and performing the work of serving God’s house.
verses.tsw_comparator: Their duty was alongside the sons of Aaron in the service of the house of the LORD: concerning the courts and the chambers, the cleansing of every holy thing, and the work of the service of the house of God;

verses.rationale: Keep each food preparation category and the measuring responsibility, with the uncertain mixed offering noted.
verses.before: also the bread of the arrangement, the fine flour for the grain offering, the unleavened wafers, what is prepared on the griddle, what is mixed, and every measure and dimension;
verses.after: They were responsible for the arranged bread, the fine flour for grain offerings, the unleavened wafers, the griddle offerings, the mixed offerings, and every quantity and measure.
verses.tsw_comparator: also the bread of the arrangement, the fine flour for the grain offering, the unleavened wafers, what is prepared on the griddle, what is mixed, and every measure and dimension;

verses.rationale: Preserve the repeated daily service and carry the list forward.
verses.before: and to stand morning by morning to give thanks and praise to the LORD, and likewise at evening;
verses.after: They were to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise every evening,
verses.tsw_comparator: and to stand morning by morning to give thanks and praise to the LORD, and likewise at evening;

verses.rationale: Keep all calendar occasions and prescribed numbers.
verses.before: and for every offering of burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, at the new moons, and at the appointed times, according to the number required of them by ordinance, continually before the LORD.
verses.after: and whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on Sabbaths, new moons, and appointed festivals, in the prescribed number, serving regularly before the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: and for every offering of burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, at the new moons, and at the appointed times, according to the number required of them by ordinance, continually before the LORD.

verses.rationale: Retain the threefold charge and the kinship of Levites and priests.
verses.before: They were to keep the charge of the tent of meeting, the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron, their relatives, for the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.after: They were to keep charge of the tent of meeting, the holy place, and the duties of their relatives, Aaron’s descendants, in the service of the LORD’s house.
verses.tsw_comparator: They were to keep the charge of the tent of meeting, the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron, their relatives, for the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Introduce the divisions through all four sons.
verses.before: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron: the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.after: These were the divisions of Aaron’s descendants. Aaron’s sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.tsw_comparator: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron: the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.rationale: Keep both reasons for the surviving priestly lines.
verses.before: Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
verses.after: Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
verses.tsw_comparator: Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

verses.rationale: Retain the two priestly affiliations and the division by duties.
verses.before: David, along with Zadok from the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech from the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their appointed duties in their service.
verses.after: David, with Zadok from Eleazar’s descendants and Ahimelech from Ithamar’s descendants, organized them according to their duties in the service.
verses.tsw_comparator: David, along with Zadok from the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech from the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their appointed duties in their service.

verses.rationale: Preserve the reason for unequal division and the sixteen-to-eight counts.
verses.before: More leaders among the men were found among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar, so they divided them: sixteen ancestral houses for the sons of Eleazar and eight for the sons of Ithamar, according to their ancestral houses.
verses.after: Eleazar’s descendants had more leading men than Ithamar’s, so they divided them accordingly: sixteen heads of ancestral houses from Eleazar’s descendants and eight from Ithamar’s.
verses.tsw_comparator: More leaders among the men were found among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar, so they divided them: sixteen ancestral houses for the sons of Eleazar and eight for the sons of Ithamar, according to their ancestral houses.

verses.rationale: Keep the shared lot procedure and both leadership descriptions.
verses.before: They divided them by lots, these alongside those, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among the sons of Eleazar and among the sons of Ithamar.
verses.after: They assigned both groups by lot, for leaders of the sanctuary and leaders in God’s service came from both Eleazar’s and Ithamar’s descendants.
verses.tsw_comparator: They divided them by lots, these alongside those, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among the sons of Eleazar and among the sons of Ithamar.

verses.rationale: Preserve all witnesses and render the difficult selection clause without inventing a precise alternating ratio.
verses.before: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, the scribe from among the Levites, recorded them before the king, the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of the ancestral houses of the priests and Levites: one ancestral house was selected for Eleazar, and one was selected—one was selected—for Ithamar.
verses.after: The Levitical scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel recorded them before the king and the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of the priestly and Levitical ancestral houses. One ancestral house was selected for Eleazar, and one was selected for Ithamar.
verses.tsw_comparator: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, the scribe from among the Levites, recorded them before the king, the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of the ancestral houses of the priests and Levites: one ancestral house was selected for Eleazar, and one was selected—one was selected—for Ithamar.

verses.rationale: Retain the first two assignments and continue the roster across labels.
verses.before: The first lot came out for Jehoiarib; the second for Jedaiah;
verses.after: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.tsw_comparator: The first lot came out for Jehoiarib; the second for Jedaiah;

verses.rationale: Preserve the third and fourth names and order.
verses.before: the third for Harim; the fourth for Seorim;
verses.after: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.tsw_comparator: the third for Harim; the fourth for Seorim;

verses.rationale: Keep both assignments at their source ordinals.
verses.before: the fifth for Malchijah; the sixth for Mijamin;
verses.after: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.tsw_comparator: the fifth for Malchijah; the sixth for Mijamin;

verses.rationale: Preserve Abijah’s eighth division for later biblical connections.
verses.before: the seventh for Hakkoz; the eighth for Abijah;
verses.after: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.tsw_comparator: the seventh for Hakkoz; the eighth for Abijah;

verses.rationale: Retain both names without conflating Jeshua with another bearer.
verses.before: the ninth for Jeshua; the tenth for Shecaniah;
verses.after: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.tsw_comparator: the ninth for Jeshua; the tenth for Shecaniah;

verses.rationale: Keep the two ordinals and names.
verses.before: the eleventh for Eliashib; the twelfth for Jakim;
verses.after: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.tsw_comparator: the eleventh for Eliashib; the twelfth for Jakim;

verses.rationale: Preserve the less familiar names exactly.
verses.before: the thirteenth for Huppah; the fourteenth for Jeshebeab;
verses.after: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.tsw_comparator: the thirteenth for Huppah; the fourteenth for Jeshebeab;

verses.rationale: Retain the sequence through the sixteenth division.
verses.before: the fifteenth for Bilgah; the sixteenth for Immer;
verses.after: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.tsw_comparator: the fifteenth for Bilgah; the sixteenth for Immer;

verses.rationale: Keep both names and their assigned positions.
verses.before: the seventeenth for Hezir; the eighteenth for Happizzez;
verses.after: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
verses.tsw_comparator: the seventeenth for Hezir; the eighteenth for Happizzez;

verses.rationale: Retain the distinct Jehezkel form.
verses.before: the nineteenth for Pethahiah; the twentieth for Jehezkel;
verses.after: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
verses.tsw_comparator: the nineteenth for Pethahiah; the twentieth for Jehezkel;

verses.rationale: Preserve both late-roster assignments.
verses.before: the twenty-first for Jakin; the twenty-second for Gamul;
verses.after: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
verses.tsw_comparator: the twenty-first for Jakin; the twenty-second for Gamul;

verses.rationale: Close the full twenty-four-division sequence without abbreviation.
verses.before: the twenty-third for Delaiah; the twenty-fourth for Maaziah.
verses.after: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
verses.tsw_comparator: the twenty-third for Delaiah; the twenty-fourth for Maaziah.

verses.rationale: Keep the service setting and authority traced through Aaron.
verses.before: These were their appointed duties for entering the house of the LORD according to their ordinance, through Aaron their father, as the LORD, God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.after: These were their assigned duties when they entered the LORD’s house to serve, following the rule given through their ancestor Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.tsw_comparator: These were their appointed duties for entering the house of the LORD according to their ordinance, through Aaron their father, as the LORD, God of Israel, had commanded him.

verses.rationale: Retain Shubael’s form and the two generations.
verses.before: As for the remaining sons of Levi: for the sons of Amram, Shubael; for the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.after: As for the remaining descendants of Levi: from Amram’s descendants, Shubael; from Shubael’s descendants, Jehdeiah.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for the remaining sons of Levi: for the sons of Amram, Shubael; for the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

verses.rationale: Keep the branch and named leader.
verses.before: For Rehabiah: for the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
verses.after: From Rehabiah: Isshiah, the leader of Rehabiah’s descendants.
verses.tsw_comparator: For Rehabiah: for the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

verses.rationale: Retain Shelomoth here rather than harmonizing Shelomith.
verses.before: For the Izharites, Shelomoth; for the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.after: From the Izharites, Shelomoth; from Shelomoth’s descendants, Jahath.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the Izharites, Shelomoth; for the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

verses.rationale: Do not silently insert the missing Hebron heading; explain its parallel in a note.
verses.before: The sons of Jeriah: Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.after: The sons were Jeriah, Amariah second, Jahaziel third, and Jekameam fourth.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Jeriah: Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.rationale: Follow Shamir’s read form and preserve the generational sequence.
verses.before: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; for the sons of Micah, Shamir.
verses.after: From Uzziel’s descendants, Micah; from Micah’s descendants, Shamir.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; for the sons of Micah, Shamir.

verses.rationale: Keep the explicit brother relationship.
verses.before: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; for the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.after: Micah’s brother was Isshiah; from Isshiah’s descendants, Zechariah.
verses.tsw_comparator: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; for the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

verses.rationale: Retain Beno as a possible proper name and mark the difficult genealogy in a note.
verses.before: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, his son.
verses.after: Merari’s sons were Mahli and Mushi. Jaaziah’s descendant was Beno.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, his son.

verses.rationale: Preserve all four forms without silently deleting the repeated Beno.
verses.before: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, his son, Shoham, Zakkur, and Ibri.
verses.after: Merari’s descendants through Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, his son, Shoham, Zakkur, and Ibri.

verses.rationale: Keep the absence of sons without implying he had no daughters.
verses.before: For Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.after: From Mahli, Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.tsw_comparator: For Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.rationale: Preserve the repeated Kish heading and named descendant.
verses.before: For Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.
verses.after: From Kish: Jerahmeel, a descendant of Kish.
verses.tsw_comparator: For Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.

verses.rationale: Retain Jerimoth’s form and the closing family classification.
verses.before: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their ancestral houses.
verses.after: Mushi’s sons were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the Levites’ descendants by their ancestral houses.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their ancestral houses.

verses.rationale: Preserve the witnessed lot procedure and equal treatment of senior and junior members.
verses.before: They also cast lots alongside their brothers, the sons of Aaron, before King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the ancestral houses of the priests and Levites, the chief ancestral house alongside that of its younger brother.
verses.after: They too cast lots, just as their relatives, Aaron’s descendants, had done, before King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the priestly and Levitical ancestral houses. The head of the senior house stood on equal terms with his younger relative.
verses.tsw_comparator: They also cast lots alongside their brothers, the sons of Aaron, before King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the ancestral houses of the priests and Levites, the chief ancestral house alongside that of its younger brother.

verses.before: The people of Israel, according to their number—the heads of ancestral houses, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter of the divisions that came in and went out month by month, for all the months of the year—each division was twenty-four thousand.
verses.after: Here is the roster of the Israelites who served the king: the heads of ancestral houses, commanders of thousands and hundreds, and their officials, responsible for the divisions that came on duty and went off duty month by month throughout the year. Each division numbered twenty-four thousand.
verses.tsw_comparator: The people of Israel, according to their number—the heads of ancestral houses, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter of the divisions that came in and went out month by month, for all the months of the year—each division was twenty-four thousand.

verses.rationale: Keep the leader, parent, month, and full repeated count.
verses.before: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel; his division numbered twenty-four thousand.

verses.rationale: Retain the ancestral branch and monthly command.

verses.rationale: Keep both officers and the second-month assignment.

verses.rationale: Attach priest to Jehoiada and retain the separate leadership description.

verses.rationale: Retain the distinctive name and designation.

verses.after: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, from Ephraim’s descendants. His division numbered twenty-four thousand.

verses.after: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjaminites. His division numbered twenty-four thousand.

verses.after: over Ephraim’s descendants, Hoshea son of Azaziah; over half the tribe of Manasseh, Joel son of Pedaiah;

verses.rationale: Close the source’s roster without inserting absent Gad and Asher entries.

verses.rationale: Retain the inclusive age wording and the ancestral promise image.

verses.after: David did not count those twenty years old and under, because the LORD had promised to multiply Israel like the stars of heaven.

verses.tsw_comparator: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count them but did not finish; and because of this wrath came upon Israel. The number was not entered in the record of the chronicles of King David.

verses.rationale: Preserve all four storehouse locations and both administrators.

verses.after: Azmaveth son of Adiel was over the king’s treasuries. Jonathan son of Uzziah was over the storehouses in the countryside, towns, villages, and towers.
verses.tsw_comparator: Over the king’s treasuries was Azmaveth son of Adiel. Over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan son of Uzziah.

verses.rationale: Keep the agricultural labor and administrator’s parent.

verses.after: Ezri son of Chelub was over the fieldworkers who cultivated the ground.
verses.tsw_comparator: Over those who did the work of the field, for cultivating the ground, was Ezri son of Chelub.

verses.rationale: Distinguish cultivation from storage of its product.
verses.before: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite; over what was in the vineyards for the wine storehouses was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
verses.after: Shimei the Ramathite was over the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was over the vineyard produce stored as wine.
verses.tsw_comparator: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite; over what was in the vineyards for the wine storehouses was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

verses.rationale: Keep both tree types and the oil’s separate management.
verses.before: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees in the lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite; over the stores of oil was Joash.
verses.after: Baal-hanan the Gederite was over the olive trees and sycamore figs in the foothills. Joash was over the stores of oil.
verses.tsw_comparator: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees in the lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite; over the stores of oil was Joash.

verses.rationale: Follow the read personal name and distinguish the grazing regions.
verses.before: Over the cattle grazing in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; over the cattle in the valleys was Shaphat son of Adlai.
verses.after: Shirtai the Sharonite was over the cattle grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was over the cattle in the valleys.
verses.tsw_comparator: Over the cattle grazing in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; over the cattle in the valleys was Shaphat son of Adlai.

verses.rationale: Retain the Ishmaelite designation and the animals’ specified sex.

verses.tsw_comparator: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite; over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite.

verses.rationale: Keep Jaziz’s group designation and the roster’s overall responsibility.

verses.after: Jaziz the Hagrite was over the flocks. All these were officials over King David’s property.
verses.tsw_comparator: Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite. All these were overseers of the property that belonged to King David.

verses.rationale: Retain uncle as the kinship reading and keep the princes’ attendant distinct.

verses.after: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor, a discerning man and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended the king’s sons.
verses.tsw_comparator: Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe; Jehiel son of Hacmoni was with the king’s sons.

verses.rationale: Preserve the different court titles.

verses.after: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor, and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
verses.tsw_comparator: Ahithophel was counselor to the king, and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

verses.rationale: Keep the parentage in this direction and the succession of counselors.
verses.before: After Ahithophel came Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar; and Joab was commander of the king’s army.
verses.after: After Ahithophel came Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar. Joab commanded the king’s army.
verses.tsw_comparator: After Ahithophel came Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar; and Joab was commander of the king’s army.

verses.rationale: Preserve every leadership category in a readable list within the verse.
verses.before: David assembled at Jerusalem all the officials of Israel: the officials of the tribes, the officials of the divisions serving the king, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials over all the property and livestock of the king and his sons, along with the court officials, the warriors, and every mighty warrior.
verses.after: David assembled all Israel’s officials in Jerusalem: the tribal leaders, the commanders of the divisions serving the king, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, the officials over all the property and livestock of the king and his sons, together with the court officials, the warriors, and all the capable fighting men.
verses.tsw_comparator: David assembled at Jerusalem all the officials of Israel: the officials of the tribes, the officials of the divisions serving the king, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials over all the property and livestock of the king and his sons, along with the court officials, the warriors, and every mighty warrior.

verses.rationale: Retain the standing posture, familial address, rest, and footstool image.

verses.after: King David rose to his feet and said, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people. I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, for the footstool of our God, and I made preparations to build it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then King David rose to his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people. I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God; and I made preparations to build.

verses.rationale: Preserve the successive narrowing of divine choice and the lasting kingship claim.

verses.after: Yet the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me from my whole ancestral house to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as ruler, and from the house of Judah he chose my father’s house. Among my father’s sons, he was pleased to make me king over all Israel.

verses.rationale: Keep the parenthetical abundance and the LORD’s ownership of the kingdom.

verses.tsw_comparator: I will establish his kingship forever, if he remains strong in carrying out my commandments and my judgments, as on this day.’

verses.rationale: Retain public witness, keeping and seeking, and the inheritance purpose.

verses.after: Now, before the eyes of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek out all the commands of the LORD your God. Then you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your children after you forever.

verses.rationale: Preserve the reciprocal seeking, inward scrutiny, and severe alternative.

verses.after: And you, my son Solomon, know your father’s God and serve him with a whole heart and a willing spirit. The LORD searches every heart and understands every purpose behind our thoughts. If you seek him, he will let you find him; if you abandon him, he will reject you forever.

verses.rationale: Keep the chosen task and brief closing imperative.

verses.tsw_comparator: “All this,” David said, “was put in writing from the hand of the LORD upon me; he gave me understanding of all the works of the plan.”

verses.rationale: Preserve the repeated commission and the promised presence through completion.
verses.before: Then David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not fear and do not be dismayed, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.
verses.after: David said to his son Solomon, “Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or abandon you until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not fear and do not be dismayed, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.

verses.rationale: Keep willing skill, organized service, and public support distinct.
verses.before: And see: the divisions of the priests and the Levites are for every service of God’s house. With you, for every kind of work, is every willing person skilled in every kind of service. The officials and all the people are wholly at your command.”
verses.after: The divisions of priests and Levites are ready for all the service of God’s house. Every willing person skilled in any craft will be with you for all the work. The officials and all the people are at your command.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And see: the divisions of the priests and the Levites are for every service of God’s house. With you, for every kind of work, is every willing person skilled in every kind of service. The officials and all the people are wholly at your command.”

verses.rationale: Retain the royal palace term for the temple and the contrast within David’s speech.
verses.before: Then King David said to the whole assembly, “Solomon my son, the one God has chosen, is young and inexperienced, and the work is great; for this fortress is not for a human being, but for the LORD God.
verses.after: King David said to the whole assembly, “My son Solomon, the one God has chosen, is young and inexperienced, and the work is great. This palace is for the LORD God, not for a human being.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then King David said to the whole assembly, “Solomon my son, the one God has chosen, is young and inexperienced, and the work is great; for this fortress is not for a human being, but for the LORD God.

verses.rationale: Preserve the full materials list while noting uncertain ancient stone identifications.
verses.before: With all my strength I have prepared for the house of my God: gold for the goldwork, silver for the silverwork, bronze for the bronzework, iron for the ironwork, and wood for the woodwork; onyx stones and stones for setting, antimony and colored stones, every kind of precious stone, and marble in abundance.
verses.after: With all my strength I have prepared for my God’s house: gold for the gold work, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the woodwork; onyx stones and stones for settings, dark stones and colored stones, every kind of precious stone, and marble in abundance.
verses.tsw_comparator: With all my strength I have prepared for the house of my God: gold for the goldwork, silver for the silverwork, bronze for the bronzework, iron for the ironwork, and wood for the woodwork; onyx stones and stones for setting, antimony and colored stones, every kind of precious stone, and marble in abundance.

verses.rationale: Keep the personal gift distinct from previously prepared resources.
verses.before: Moreover, because of my delight in the house of my God, I have a personal treasure of gold and silver, and I have given it to the house of my God, beyond all that I have prepared for the holy house:
verses.after: Besides this, because I delight in my God’s house, I am giving my own treasure of gold and silver to my God’s house, beyond everything I have prepared for the holy house:
verses.tsw_comparator: Moreover, because of my delight in the house of my God, I have a personal treasure of gold and silver, and I have given it to the house of my God, beyond all that I have prepared for the holy house:

verses.rationale: Retain both ancient weights and the gold’s provenance.
verses.before: three thousand talents of gold from the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for overlaying the walls of the buildings;
verses.after: three thousand talents of gold from Ophir and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay the walls of the buildings,
verses.tsw_comparator: three thousand talents of gold from the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for overlaying the walls of the buildings;

verses.rationale: Render filling the hand as consecration and connect willingness to the gift appeal.
verses.before: gold for the goldwork, silver for the silverwork, and for every work by the hands of craftspeople. Who, then, is willing to fill their hand today for the LORD?”
verses.after: gold for the gold work and silver for the silver work, and for everything the craftsmen make. Who, then, is willing to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”
verses.tsw_comparator: gold for the goldwork, silver for the silverwork, and for every work by the hands of craftspeople. Who, then, is willing to fill their hand today for the LORD?”

verses.rationale: Preserve every donor group and the recurring willingness.
verses.before: Then the heads of the families, the leaders of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the overseers of the king’s work gave willingly.
verses.after: Then the heads of ancestral houses, the tribal leaders of Israel, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the officials over the king’s work gave willingly.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the heads of the families, the leaders of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the overseers of the king’s work gave willingly.

verses.rationale: Keep all quantities and the later coin term darics rather than disguising it.
verses.before: They gave for the service of God’s house five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand darics, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.after: For the service of God’s house they gave five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.tsw_comparator: They gave for the service of God’s house five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand darics, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.rationale: Retain the voluntary possessors and named custodian.
verses.before: People who possessed stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.after: Those who had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the LORD’s house, under Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those who possessed stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.

verses.rationale: Preserve the repeated willingness, whole-heart language, and shared joy.
verses.before: Then the people rejoiced because of their willingness, for with a whole heart they had given willingly to the LORD. King David also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.after: The people rejoiced over their willing gifts, for they had given willingly to the LORD with a whole heart. King David also rejoiced greatly.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the people rejoiced because of their willingness, for with a whole heart they had given willingly to the LORD. King David also rejoiced with great joy.

verses.rationale: Take our father with Israel while recording the alternative divine address in a note.
verses.before: Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of the whole assembly. David said: “Blessed are you, LORD, God of Israel our father, from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.after: David blessed the LORD before the whole assembly. He said, “Blessed are you, LORD, God of Israel our father, from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of the whole assembly. David said: “Blessed are you, LORD, God of Israel our father, from everlasting to everlasting.

verses.rationale: Keep every praise attribute and the comprehensive royal claim.
verses.before: Yours, LORD, are the greatness and the power and the splendor and the victory and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth is yours. Yours, LORD, is the kingdom, and you are exalted as head over all.
verses.after: Yours, LORD, are greatness, power, splendor, victory, and majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth is yours. Yours, LORD, is the kingdom, and you are exalted as head over all.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yours, LORD, are the greatness and the power and the splendor and the victory and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth is yours. Yours, LORD, is the kingdom, and you are exalted as head over all.

verses.rationale: Retain both hand images and both greatness and strengthening.
verses.before: Riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all. In your hand are power and might, and in your hand it is to make great and to strengthen all.
verses.after: Wealth and honor come from you, and you rule over all. Power and might are in your hand, and in your hand is the strength to make anyone great and strong.
verses.tsw_comparator: Riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all. In your hand are power and might, and in your hand it is to make great and to strengthen all.

verses.rationale: Keep thanksgiving and praise directed toward the Name.
verses.before: Now, our God, we give thanks to you and praise your glorious name.
verses.after: Now, our God, we give you thanks and praise your glorious name.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now, our God, we give thanks to you and praise your glorious name.

verses.rationale: Preserve the question and reciprocal giving grounded in divine provision.
verses.before: “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should have strength to give willingly like this? For everything comes from you, and from your hand we have given to you.
verses.after: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should have the strength to give so willingly? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should have strength to give willingly like this? For everything comes from you, and from your hand we have given to you.

verses.rationale: Retain both resident-status terms and the mortal shadow image, making the contextual object of hope clear.
verses.before: For we are sojourners before you, and residents, like all our ancestors. Our days on the earth are like a shadow, and there is no hope.
verses.after: We are foreigners and temporary residents before you, like all our ancestors. Our days on earth are like a shadow, with no hope of lasting.
verses.tsw_comparator: For we are sojourners before you, and residents, like all our ancestors. Our days on the earth are like a shadow, and there is no hope.

verses.rationale: Preserve the hand image and total divine ownership.
verses.before: the LORD our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand; it all belongs to you.
verses.after: LORD our God, all this abundance we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and it all belongs to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: the LORD our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand; it all belongs to you.

verses.rationale: Keep testing and the repeated uprightness and willingness.
verses.before: I know, my God, that you test the heart and delight in uprightness. In the uprightness of my heart I have willingly given all these things, and now I have seen your people who are present here giving willingly to you with joy.
verses.after: I know, my God, that you test the heart and delight in uprightness. With an upright heart I have willingly given all these things, and now I have seen your people here giving willingly to you with joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know, my God, that you test the heart and delight in uprightness. In the uprightness of my heart I have willingly given all these things, and now I have seen your people who are present here giving willingly to you with joy.

verses.rationale: Retain Israel’s name and both the preservation and direction petitions.
verses.before: LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our ancestors, preserve this forever as the purpose of the thoughts of your people’s heart, and direct their heart toward you.
verses.after: LORD, God of our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep this forever in the purposes and thoughts of your people’s hearts. Direct their hearts toward you.
verses.tsw_comparator: LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our ancestors, preserve this forever as the purpose of the thoughts of your people’s heart, and direct their heart toward you.

verses.rationale: Keep all three instruction terms, whole-heartedness, and the temple-palace vocabulary.
verses.before: Give Solomon my son a whole heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, to do all of them, and to build the fortress for which I have made preparation.”
verses.after: Give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep your commands, testimonies, and statutes, to carry them all out, and to build the palace for which I have made preparations.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Give Solomon my son a whole heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, to do all of them, and to build the fortress for which I have made preparation.”

verses.rationale: Preserve the shared bodily homage without implying identical divine status.
verses.before: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God.” So the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their ancestors, and they bowed down and prostrated themselves before the LORD and before the king.
verses.after: Then David told the whole assembly, “Bless the LORD your God.” The whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their ancestors. They bowed low and paid homage to the LORD and to the king.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God.” So the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their ancestors, and they bowed down and prostrated themselves before the LORD and before the king.

verses.rationale: Retain the next-day timing and all three thousand-animal categories.
verses.before: The next day they offered sacrifices to the LORD and presented burnt offerings to the LORD: one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
verses.after: The next day they offered sacrifices to the LORD and presented burnt offerings to him: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and abundant sacrifices for all Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: The next day they offered sacrifices to the LORD and presented burnt offerings to the LORD: one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

verses.rationale: Preserve the explicit second installation and the separate priestly anointing.
verses.before: They ate and drank before the LORD that day with great joy. Then they made Solomon son of David king a second time, and anointed him for the LORD as leader, and Zadok as priest.
verses.after: They ate and drank before the LORD that day with great joy. They made Solomon son of David king a second time, anointing him before the LORD as ruler and Zadok as priest.
verses.tsw_comparator: They ate and drank before the LORD that day with great joy. Then they made Solomon son of David king a second time, and anointed him for the LORD as leader, and Zadok as priest.

verses.rationale: Retain the LORD’s throne and the all-Israel response.
verses.before: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of David his father. He prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.after: Solomon sat on the LORD’s throne as king in place of his father David. He prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.tsw_comparator: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of David his father. He prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.

verses.rationale: Render the hand-under gesture as allegiance while retaining all three groups.
verses.before: All the leaders and the warriors, and also all the sons of King David, pledged allegiance to King Solomon.
verses.after: All the officials and warriors, and all King David’s sons as well, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
verses.tsw_comparator: All the leaders and the warriors, and also all the sons of King David, pledged allegiance to King Solomon.

verses.rationale: Keep the unparalleled royal claim within the narrator’s scope.
verses.before: The LORD made Solomon exceedingly great in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal majesty such as no king before him over Israel had possessed.
verses.after: The LORD made Solomon exceedingly great in the eyes of all Israel and gave him royal majesty such as no king over Israel before him had possessed.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD made Solomon exceedingly great in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal majesty such as no king before him over Israel had possessed.

verses.rationale: Preserve the concluding royal identity and father’s name.
verses.before: David son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.after: David son of Jesse had reigned over all Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: David son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

verses.rationale: Retain all three reign figures without importing the months from Samuel.
verses.before: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years: he reigned seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.after: He reigned over Israel for forty years: seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
verses.tsw_comparator: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years: he reigned seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

verses.rationale: Keep the full-of-days image and succession formula.
verses.before: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
verses.after: He died at a good old age, full of days, wealth, and honor. His son Solomon became king in his place.
verses.tsw_comparator: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

verses.rationale: Preserve all three named records and both prophetic titles.
verses.before: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are written in the records of Samuel the seer, in the records of Nathan the prophet, and in the records of Gad the seer,
verses.after: The acts of King David, from first to last, are written in the records of Samuel the seer, Nathan the prophet, and Gad the seer,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are written in the records of Samuel the seer, in the records of Nathan the prophet, and in the records of Gad the seer,

verses.rationale: Retain the widening historical scope of the book’s final sentence.
verses.before: together with all his reign and his power, and the times that passed over him and over Israel and over all the kingdoms of the lands.
verses.after: together with his whole reign, his mighty deeds, and the times that passed over him, over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the lands.
verses.tsw_comparator: together with all his reign and his power, and the times that passed over him and over Israel and over all the kingdoms of the lands.
